description:
Container process identity and filesystem security.

Absent means `restricted` with the image's own non-root user.

profile.description: Runtime security profile. `unrestricted` is the explicit opt-out.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the root filesystem read-only. Defaults to true under `restricted`.

runAsGroup.description: Numeric GID for the container process. Defaults to the image's group.

runAsUser.description:
Numeric UID for the container process. Defaults to the image's user,
which must not be root.

writablePaths.description: Absolute paths backed by a writable emptyDir. `/tmp` is always writable.
